name: mark and wordmark settle on a dark card
looks: Two interlocking rings sit still above centre on a plain dark field. The wordmark fades in beneath them as a single settled block, followed by a short descriptor line a beat later.
build: The rings are a static SVG mark; the wordmark fades/rises 6-8px in as one block (not staggered per letter); the descriptor line fades in after a short pause at lower opacity.
sound: A soft low swell under the hold and a light confirm tone as the wordmark lands.
prompt: Hold a simple interlocking mark still above centre on a plain dark field, fade the wordmark in beneath it as one settled block, then fade in a short descriptor line a beat later underneath.
